errors.expected_operand: Expected a species, a unit-bearing energy or a parenthesized expression.
errors.unknown_alias: Alias not found; choose a suggested reference.
errors.dimension_mismatch: The two sides have different dimensions.
errors.energy_multiplication_forbidden: Multiplying two energies is not supported.
errors.energy_expression_required: The final expression must have energy dimensions.
errors.expression_too_complex: Too many expression nodes; simplify the expression.
errors.expression_too_long: Valid expressions are limited to 8192 characters; the current text is saved as a draft.
errors.invalid_reference_token: Invalid reference token; choose the source again.
errors.unclosed_reference: Reference token is missing its closing brace.
errors.unclosed_unit: Unit is missing its closing bracket.
errors.unknown_unit: Unknown unit; use Eh, kcal/mol or kJ/mol.
